basic_info.description: Unparalleled, unobstructed panoramic views of San Francisco's skyline and bay pour into every room of this top-floor home, an exceptional residence in angle, design, and vistas. Thoughtfully renovated with premium materials and refined craftsmanship, this luxurious 3BR/2BA Smart Home balances stunning visibility with serene privacy. Brazilian walnut floors, frosted-glass doors, skylights, and high-performance sound insulation create a refined living experience. A 7-zone Sonos system with in-ceiling speakers and app control enhances every room. The open layout centers around a chef's kitchen with Sub-Zero fridge, Viking stove, quartz countertops, custom cabinetry, and built-in bar with wine fridge. A reverse osmosis water system and in-unit laundry add everyday ease. Both bathrooms feature floor-to-ceiling Venetian marble; one with a Jacuzzi tub, the other a 4-headed spa-style shower. All bedrooms and the living room open to a private deck through high-performance sliding glass doors, maximizing light and indoor-outdoor flow. Includes a private garage by the entrance and a large storage room. Ideally located beneath Twin Peaks with quick access to shopping and citywide destinations, this home offers the comfort of a single-family residence with condo convenience.
